{
  "name": "string or null",
  "phone": "string or null",
  "course_interest": "python | web_development | data_science | digital_marketing | other | null",

Mapping rules for course_interest:
- python, py, Python for Professionals, python course → python
- web, web development, full stack, fullstack, Full Stack Web Development → web_development
- data science, data, ML, machine learning, AI, Data Science & ML → data_science
- digital marketing, marketing, Digital Marketing Mastery → digital_marketing
- anything else course related → other
- no course mentioned → null

Mapping rules for intent:
- asking about a course, new contact → new_enquiry
- following up, asking again → follow_up
- asking for help, what courses, list courses → help
- complaint or issue → complaint
- general chat → general"
